description: This file contains a PHP function 'smarty_core_write_compiled_include' responsible for extracting non-cacheable parts from Smarty compiled templates, converting them into PHP functions, and writing the resulting code to a file. It is part of the Smarty templating engine's internal plugin system.

methods.name: smarty_core_write_compiled_include
methods.description: Processes compiled Smarty template content to extract non-cacheable parts, converts them into PHP functions, and writes the code to a specified file.
